gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: The Twentynine Palms Art Gallery is a landmark in the City of Twentynine Palms. Gallery hours are 11-3, Friday - Sunday. We're located at 74055 Cottonwood Drive at National Park Drive in 29 Palms and just minutes from Joshua Tree National Park. Exhibitions change monthly, with an opening reception on the first Saturday of each month, 4-6 PM (5-7 in July and August).
